title: Workspace executive context
description: Use when reviewing or changing the LPM workspace executive context (contexto executivo): readiness (prontidão), gaps, operating model, executive roles, routing/escalation policy, unowned domains or capabilities (sem dono), alignment. Not for project settings (use lpm-workspace-admin).
doneWhen: The apply returned an `auditEventId`, the read-back shows the patch with `lastReviewedAt` = `appliedAt` and its closed gap ids are gone, or the review-only report was delivered.
authorityCeiling: Reads and drafts [A]; the apply [O], only for the exact patch the workspace owner approved; routing-profile and description fixes [C].
jobs: o workspace está pronto para operação assistida? gere o relatório de prontidão
quais papéis executivos estão sem responsável no workspace?
o domínio <nome> está sem dono: qual projeto assume?
list the executive context gaps of workspace <workspaceId> by gap id
draft an operating model and a routing policy for the owner to review
set the executive context mission to the text the owner gave
apply the executive-context patch the owner approved
check project alignment and fix the misaligned routing profile

notFor.when: project settings, project governance roles, members, or a project's routing profile outside a gap fix
roadmap capability records (ids, owners, item links)
routing one concrete intake entry or WhatsApp protocol to a project
project or portfolio delivery health, risks or a weekly review
budgets, AI limits, AI models or AISH money
API keys, agent credentials or agent principals

sharedRefs.name: authority-and-owner-decisions
sharedRefs.loadWhen: an [O] apply is next, or the owner's order is missing and you write the decision request

sharedRefs.name: idempotency-and-retries
sharedRefs.loadWhen: an apply or a routing-profile update timed out or returned an unclear result

references.loadWhen: you draft, edit, apply or read back an executive-context patch
you read a readiness report, a validation or a gap list

codex.shortDescription: Review and change the LPM workspace executive context
codex.defaultPrompt: Use $lpm-executive-context to review the readiness of LPM workspace <workspaceId>.
